verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents an Export API for pulling raw project event data (amplitude-docs-12) and a Dashboard REST API that returns chart and analysis results as JSON (amplitude-docs-30). It also offers cohort export endpoints (amplitude-docs-29) and publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (amplitude-probe-3). Together these cover both halves of the story, but each is backed only by a one-line doc mention. missing for 10: detail on query flexibility (ad-hoc or SQL-style querying rather than prebuilt chart outputs), export limits, formats and latency, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the query/export APIs.
